signoffNote: EMPTY BY DESIGN. Doses are never generated by the model. An entry may be added here only by a clinician, with the guideline name, edition/year and section it was taken from. Until then the clinician view shows the drug name and a pointer to the guideline, never a number.
defaultPointer: Dose per the current NDoH Standard Treatment Guidelines and Essential Medicines List, or the relevant SA HIV Clinicians Society guideline. Verify against the current edition.

entryShape.dose: full dose text as written in the source
